Participants underwent olfactory stimulation with alcohol, appetitive control and non-appetitive odors and reported odor presence or absence.

instructions.value: Subjects were instructed to sniff during odor events and report whether an odorant was present by pressing button 1 for presence or button 2 for absence; they were not asked to identify the odorants.

stimuli.value: Alcohol odors consisting of each subject's two most frequently consumed alcoholic drinks, appetitive control odors of chocolate and grape juice, non-appetitive odors selected from grass, leather, lilac, and Douglas fir, and odorless control events; no pictures were presented during imaging.
